notes: Companies House 15549537 (CUSP AI LIMITED), incorporated 9 Mar 2024. SH01 allotments: 18 Jun 2024 and 5 Jul 2024 (seed), 22 Nov 2024 (small), 4 Aug, 14 Aug, 2 Sep, 26 Sep, 6 Nov 2025 (Series A tranches), 18 Mar 2026 (unannounced; share capital rose ~11%), 17 Aug 2026 (Series B). The 18 Mar 2026 allotment has no matching press release.

First accounts (13 months to 31 Mar 2025) are group accounts with overseas undertakings (Amsterdam staff appear in job ads); they record GBP 22m cash and say the group raised 'over $100m' in Sept 2025. Year end moved to 31 Dec; accounts to 31 Dec 2025 are not yet filed.
Disclosed rounds sum to USD 580M; tech.eu reports more than USD 670M raised in total.
Welling and Edwards ceased to be persons with significant control on 4 Aug 2025 (dilution at the Series A).
Leadership start dates for the VPs and senior director are first-seen dates on the live site, not hire dates; Wayback history of the team section was not checked.
OpenAlex has no institution record; raw-affiliation search finds 59 works and 10 distinct CuspAI-affiliated authors (5 in 2025, 7 in 2026), a lower bound on publishing staff.

Current openings function mapping: program managers, developer relations, partnerships, ecosystem and talent roles -> business-ops; data engineer -> software-eng; application scientists -> materials-science; internship and agents engineer -> ml-research.
Posting history merges 6 Wayback-captured Ashby posting IDs (board first captured Oct 2025) with live Ashby publishedAt dates; earliest date per ID wins. Hiring before Oct 2025 is invisible here.
Older LinkedIn captures (Jul 2024, Apr and Dec 2025) exist in Wayback but were not re-read after the gzip fix; only the Aug 2026 capture is used.
